g.text: entry_type : VARCHAR (TOPUP | DEBIT | CREDIT | HOLD | HOLD_RELEASE | FEE_INCOME | COMMISSION | REVERSAL)
biller_account_ref : VARCHAR (meter number or phone number)
status : VARCHAR (INITIATED | FUNDS_HELD | SENT_TO_BILLER | COMPLETED | FAILED | UNKNOWN | REJECTED | REFUNDED)
failure_reason : VARCHAR (null, set for REJECTED and FAILED)
rule_name : VARCHAR (DAILY_BASIC | DAILY_VERIFIED | VELOCITY_COUNT | VELOCITY_WINDOW_SECONDS | VELOCITY_BLOCK_MINUTES)
The holds table records each hold and its status;
it is not used to compute the balance.
holds PayLink fee income and pays refunds (D-18).
available_delta and held_delta give the direction of each movement;
Min and max payment amount are NOT here:
they are stored once in biller_services.min_amount
Refund of a COMPLETED payment returns the FULL
total_amount (bill + fee) to the customer via
also reversing fee income and agent commission;
PayLink absorbs any commission shortfall (D-13, D-14).
enforced in code (insert and read only), plus DB-level
hardening as a deployment rule: revoke UPDATE and DELETE
on audit_logs for the application user (US-25.2).
Every ledger entry and every admin action is audited.
